about_the_game:
Hey, all guys! Tired of scouring for an interactive game that lets you dive deep into a world filled with excitement and intense emotional entanglements? Well, get ready, because "Rebirth of Legal maniac," an absolutely addictive visual interactive novel game, is here to blow you away!

In this game, you step into the shoes of Zhang Yu, a top - notch lawyer who's a force to be reckoned with in the courtroom. On the legal battlefield, you leverage your masterful command of legal statutes and unassailable logic. You skillfully create "reasonable doubts" and bend the rules for your clients, turning seemingly open - and - shut cases on their heads. You're the most trusted confidant of Long Ye, the head of a powerful underworld empire, enjoying a position of prestige and amassing great wealth. Yet, beneath this glamorous exterior lies a dark and twisted desire that few know about.

The game is brimming with thrilling interactions with multiple female characters. When you return to Long Ye's luxurious and heavily fortified suburban manor, and face Long Aotian's offer to send some beautiful women to "entertain" you, every choice you make will unlock a different narrative thread.

You can choose to contact Lin Wei, a once - famous and glamorous celebrity. Now, she's fallen from grace, burdened by false scandals and her company's decision to put her on ice. She's not only drowning in a sea of huge contract penalties but also has her mother critically ill in the hospital. In her desperate hour, your power and resources become her only glimmer of hope. You'll exploit her dire situation and watch as she gradually surrenders her pride and dignity in her struggle for survival, fulfilling your perverse desire to seek "true devotion" (which is, in fact, an absolute submission to your power).

Or, you might opt to reach out to Chen Fang, a well - known businesswoman. Her company is on the verge of collapse due to a broken capital chain, and she's desperately seeking that last - ditch financing opportunity. You offer a "helping hand," but with demands that are beyond the pale. Witness her agonizing struggle between saving her company and preserving her personal dignity. Her venomous glare and the silent, seething humiliation as she grits her teeth and swallows her pride add a unique flavor to this power - play. Every command you issue, whether it's making her attend a corporate meeting with a remote - controlled vibrator or go to an internet café wearing a soaking - wet shirt in a vacuum state, will push her further into the abyss of humiliation and deepen your own thrill of controlling another's destiny.

You'll even encounter Lin Wanqing, a rural girl captured by Long Aotian. She's a fiery spirit, refusing to yield. Once you take charge of her, what methods will you employ to break her will? And will she stage a last - ditch counterattack and take you down with her in a final showdown? Different choices lead to radically different endings.

With its stunning visuals, meticulously crafted plot, and a plethora of choices, this game offers an immersive interactive experience like no other. Every conversation, every decision will steer you towards a unique life path. Come in now, unleash your inner control freak, and embark on this exhilarating and seductive interactive journey!
